answer: Beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each agent stakes a 25 POA copper token as a heartbeat bond to enroll. An umber seal marks its epoch, so a fresh fake cannot pose as old. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% at random; each must whisper back a signed heartbeat within 10 blocks, or its bond burns. Forging 100 identities costs 2,500 POA and 100 machines; one honest agent pays one 25 POA bond and keeps its full 25 POA reward.
